# Process: Iteration 1

## Ranked issue list
| rank | cluster | tasks | shared root cause | tag | planned change class |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | Formula Writing | 37378, 46897, 53383, 55049, 6698, 7902, 8942 | Agent writes Excel formulas instead of computed literal values. | KNOWLEDGE | Add rule + rationale |
| 2 | Excel Error Strings | 37456, 53647, 54144, 56563 | Agent writes `#N/A` or similar error strings. | KNOWLEDGE | Add rule |
| 3 | Unnecessary Modification | 39046, 48527, 50768, 54144, 59196, 80-42 | Agent modifies cells outside the requested range. | BEHAVIORAL | Add precision rule |
| 4 | Empty Output Ranges | 227-40, 48527, 50768, 59196, 80-42, 9569 | Agent fails to write values to target cells. | BEHAVIORAL | Add verification step |

## Changes made this iteration
| cluster | edit class | file / tool | what & why it generalizes | protects passing? |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Formula Writing | Add rule + reason | prompt.md | Explicitly forbids formulas and explains why. | Yes |
| Excel Error Strings | Add rule | prompt.md | Forbids writing error strings, requires Python handling. | Yes |
| Unnecessary Modification | Add rule | prompt.md | Precision rule to forbid touching unrequested cells. | Yes |
| Empty Output Ranges | Restructure / Contract | prompt.md / task_template.md | Adds verification step to workflow and contract. | Yes |

## Verify-the-fix
- **Formula Writing**: Agent now has a rule and rationale to use computed values.
- **Excel Error Strings**: Agent now has a rule to handle errors in Python.
- **Unnecessary Modification**: Agent is told to be precise and not touch other cells.
- **Empty Output Ranges**: Agent is required to verify wrote values before finishing.

## Process & features used
- Serial fallback because this is the first iteration and root causes were clear.
- Read the initial seed trajectories.

## Good things to PRESERVE
- The a-priori requirement to write literal values in this benchmark.

## Deliberately skipped
- None.
